title: 북한인권기록보존소 운영규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00954:20190621:00002:part:1/1

ADDENDUM <Ministry of Justice Rule No. 954, June 21, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Applicability concerning Retention Periods)
The amended provisions of Article 3 shall also apply to materials transferred before these Rules enter into force.
